answer: By the whisper of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The design leans on escrowed payment for graded work, weighted by independent path length, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work. Each submission hangs on the ferrous of a task receipt, and the island is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short.
